csv_scope_of_work: City of Bozeman (City) is seeking qualifications from firms or teams of firms to provide transportation planning services to complete the City s 2027 Transportation Master Plan (TMP) update. This project will update the City s existing 2017 Transportation Master Plan to align with current policy, planning, and prioritization of capital transportation projects. This TMP update will serve as the compliant transportation facility plan under the Montana Land Use Planning Act (MLUPA).
csv_disciplines_requested: Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Public Transit Planning, Transportation Planning
